name: Kuntz HoLEP versus open prostatectomy
question: How do holmium laser enucleation and transvesical open prostatectomy compare in obstructed men with prostates larger than 100 g?

arms.label: Holmium laser enucleation of the prostate

design.population: 120 urodynamically obstructed men with prostate size greater than 100 g on transrectal ultrasonography.
design.locator: Primary PubMed abstract, Materials and Methods; 18-month PubMed abstract, Patients and Methods

verdictNote: Voiding improvements were similar; HoLEP reduced perioperative morbidity, but no prespecified primary threshold was reported.
takeaway: In obstructed men with prostates larger than 100 g, holmium laser enucleation and transvesical open prostatectomy produced similar six-month voiding improvements; enucleation had less blood loss, shorter catheterization and hospitalization, and fewer transfusions, but longer operating time.

reports.label: Six-month primary report
reports.dateLocator: PubMed citation, October 2002; day not reported
reports.citation: Kuntz RM, Lehrich K. "Transurethral holmium laser enucleation versus transvesical open enucleation for prostate adenoma greater than 100 gm.: a randomized prospective trial of 120 patients." *J Urol.* 2002;168(4 Pt 1):1465-1469. doi:10.1016/S0022-5347(05)64475-8

results.endpoint: AUA symptom score, peak flow and postvoid residual
results.note: The abstract does not identify a prespecified primary endpoint or between-arm threshold.
results.locator: PubMed abstract, Materials and Methods and Results

harms.label: Blood transfusion
harms.note: Arm denominators of 60 each are stated in the later report.

values.exp: longer operation, less blood loss, shorter catheterization and hospital stay
values.ctl: shorter operation, more blood loss, longer catheterization and hospital stay

reports.label: 18-month follow-up
reports.dateLocator: PubMed citation, March 2004; day not reported
reports.citation: Kuntz RM, Lehrich K, Ahyai S. "Transurethral holmium laser enucleation of the prostate compared with transvesical open prostatectomy: 18-month follow-up of a randomized trial." *J Endourol.* 2004;18(2):189-191. doi:10.1089/089277904322959851

results.endpoint: AUA symptom score, peak flow and postvoid residual
results.note: Within-arm improvement P < 0.0001; no between-arm endpoint values in abstract.
